name: When do I need a general contractor for framing a small addition?

mainEntity.name: When do I need a general contractor for framing a small addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: You need a general contractor for framing a small addition when you require expertise in project management, code compliance, and coordinating various trades. A contractor ensures the framing adheres to architectural plans, secures necessary permits, and manages the team building the structure. Their involvement is crucial for a smooth process, especially if the project involves structural modifications to the existing home or complex design elements, ensuring safety and quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor is needed for framing to manage the project, ensure code compliance, coordinate trades, and handle permitting for your small addition.
